package.name: tilt_axis_bridge
package.description: PC-side ROS2 node for the LiDAR scanner's tilt axis. Talks to the MKS SERVO42/57D driver over RS485 via a transparent USB<->RS485 bridge (an FTDI FT232-family off-the-shelf adapter as of 2026-08-31; originally a Raspberry Pi Pico running custom bridge firmware), replacing the ESP32/micro-ROS firmware after an unresolved ESP32 RS485 receive-path fault.
